entry.title: New: Bill 30 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE TO CHANGE ZONING FROM RURAL TO M-1 LIGHT INDUSTRIAL (CONDITIONAL ZONING) FOR PROPERTY SITUATED AT KIHEI, MAUI, HAWAII TAX MAP KEY (2) 3-9-001:034" The purpose of this bill is to change zoning from Rural to M-1 Light Industrial (conditional zoning) for the Ohukai Light Industrial Park situated at Kihei, Maui, Hawaii.
